summary: Phase 2 Admin Billing UI end-to-end retest against admin@fourbuy.co.za on TEST_Billing_5af6e7e2. Login blocker from iter 62 is resolved (testID='login-submit-button' is present and works). All 5 cockpit action buttons and 6 primary testIDs are FOUND. Verified flows: Deposit Request (DEPOSITS 2→3 with note 'TEST_deposit_request_new' persisted), Load Payment R1000+bank_ref=TEST-01 (Balance R4500→R5500 in the left column after refresh — PASS), Refund R500 (Balance R5500→R5000, REFUNDS 1→2 — PASS), Generate Invoice modal (year=2026,month=8 render cleanly, no crash), Statement PDF (HTTP 200, Content-Type: application/pdf, opened new blob tab — PASS), Company Settings PUT persisted trading_name='TRADE AI powered by FOURBUY (test)' across reload — PASS. Dealer create modal: all 3 accounts_contact_* testIDs present. State-reset regression from iter 62 bug #1 is FIXED — filling accounts_contact_email, closing via Cancel, reopening yields a blank field. Full dealership persistence via API not completed because the modal has a 2-step flow ('Create & Add User') that requires user details before the dealership is written; main agent should verify via a full flow.  CRITICAL NEW BUG DISCOVERED: every modal PrimaryButton renders with invisible label (white text on the neon-white brand primary background). Affected across Deposit Request 'Create & Email', Load Payment 'Record Payment', Generate Invoice 'Generate & Email', Refund 'Record Refund', and Company Settings 'Save' — the buttons are functional but the caption is unreadable. Root cause: /app/frontend/src/components/AdminBillingCockpit.tsx line 835: `primaryBtnText: { color: '#fff' }` — same class of bug already fixed on `actionBtnTextPrimary` (line 800 uses colors.onPrimary). Should be `color: colors.onPrimary || '#000'`.

ui_bugs.issue: primaryBtnText hard-codes color:'#fff' on line 835 while backgroundColor uses colors.primary (light/neon on the current theme). Result: the submit button in EVERY billing modal (Deposit Request, Load Payment, Generate Invoice, Refund, Company Settings) shows a blank white bar with no visible label — WCAG contrast failure and a UX blocker. Fix: change to `color: colors.onPrimary || '#fff'` to mirror the actionBtnTextPrimary fix at line 800. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AdminBillingCockpit.tsx:835.

PrimaryButton has no testID prop, forcing testing agents to fall back to get_by_text('Create & Email'/'Record Payment'/etc). Suggest passing a `testID` prop into PrimaryButton (e.g. testID='modal-submit-deposit', 'modal-submit-load-pay', ...) so future regression tests are deterministic.

issues: Submit button is labelled 'Create & Add User' which is a 2-step flow — a Cancel-only user-form step should be allowed so admins can create a dealership WITHOUT immediately provisioning a user. Consider a secondary 'Create dealership only' action.

action_items: HIGH: Fix invisible modal submit label — /app/frontend/src/components/AdminBillingCockpit.tsx line 835: change `primaryBtnText: { color: '#fff', ... }` to `primaryBtnText: { color: colors.onPrimary || '#fff', ... }`.
LOW: Add a `testID` prop to `PrimaryButton` (line 752-757) and thread through unique IDs from each of the 5 call-sites (Deposit / Load Payment / Generate Invoice / Refund / Save Company).
OPTIONAL: In dealers.tsx 'New Dealership' modal, wire a dedicated `testID='new-dealership-submit-btn'` on the 'Create & Add User' TouchableOpacity so a scripted E2E can drive it without get_by_text.

Main-agent may run a manual dealership+user creation and verify GET /api/admin/dealerships/{id}.accounts_contact echoes name/phone/email — the field-level plumbing (testIDs, state reset) is confirmed working, only the multi-step submit was not driven end-to-end by this agent.

rca_of_issue: Invisible modal submit label: /app/frontend/src/components/AdminBillingCockpit.tsx line 834-835. Style `primaryBtn` sets backgroundColor to `colors.primary` (light neon-white brand accent); `primaryBtnText` sets color to hard-coded '#fff'. On light-primary themes the two collapse into white-on-white and the label becomes invisible. Same problem was already remediated for actionBtnTextPrimary (line 800: `color: colors.onPrimary || '#fff'`). Mitigation: mirror the fix so every primary CTA text respects `colors.onPrimary`. Reproduction: any admin login → Billing → click any of the 5 modal open buttons → observe the bottom CTA renders as a plain white rectangle.
